stalls.en: Biao Ge Grilled Spicy Stinky Tofu
stalls.summaryZh: 臭豆腐以鐵板烤到表面焦香再淋麻辣醬，口感和一般炸的不同。
stalls.summaryEn: Stinky tofu seared on a griddle and doused in mala sauce, a change from the usual deep-fried style.

sources.title: 蕃薯藤旅遊：宜蘭夜市整理

stalls.summaryZh: 沒有店名的老攤，炸得酥脆、泡菜爽口，熟客多。
stalls.summaryEn: A no-name stall with crisp fried tofu and tangy pickled cabbage; many regulars.

sources.title: 蕃薯藤旅遊：宜蘭夜市整理

stalls.summaryZh: 現烤章魚燒外酥內軟，料多。
stalls.summaryEn: Freshly griddled octopus balls, crisp outside and soft inside.

sources.title: 蕃薯藤旅遊：宜蘭夜市整理

stalls.summaryZh: 自熬鳳梨果醬調成的水果茶，宜蘭各夜市都看得到。
stalls.summaryEn: Fruit tea built on house pineapple jam, a fixture at Yilan markets.

stalls.summaryZh: 巡迴各夜市的人氣炸雞，常需排隊。
